data.body: S2 (0804): fixed CI module-size overflow by moving coercion cluster (_ALIASES, _RESERVED_SECTIONS, coerce_sparse, merge_sparse) from _config_schema.py (808->733 LOC) into _config_sections.py (153->242 LOC), re-exported for back-compat. Also added warnings.cross_session to hand-authored docs/config.md (LLM-Review advisory). All green locally: lint, typecheck (680 files), check_config_reads, gen_config_reference --check, module-size (all <=800), 743 config tests + cross_session oracle. Amended commit b21554c (Change-Id I39c36deb preserved), re-pushed patchset to Gerrit 2303. Awaiting LLM-Review + Verified.
